name: PaletteDrownedNave
intent: A sunken cathedral marsh of black-green standing water and reed beds, pale grey limestone tracery breaking the surface, green-grey mist and a dim stained-glass amber as its one accent.
requests: A matte green-black standing-water surface for the marsh pools; the palette only has the dark bed beneath them.

critic_pass1.why: Green-black ground with pale limestone and a clear grey road reads, but without water it is a dark green field near B and E, and the ochre accent reads more mustard than stained glass.
critic_pass1.fix: walk mud 6 values darker and greener-black so the marsh separates from B and E, and accent nudged toward warmer amber-gold

critic_pass2.why: Mud darkened toward black-green so the pale limestone road and rock pop more, but the accent drifted to an amber-brown that sits too close to the lamp to be its own idea, and the green-black ground overlaps E and G.
